source_text:
1.5 Πρὸς τὴν ἀπὸ
σιδήρου πληγήν Καὶ τῷ πληγέντι δὲ ἀπὸ σιδήρου τόδε ὀδύνης ἄκος· τὸν τρώσαντα
σίδηρον ἀλεῖψαι προσήκει, εἶτ' ἐπικροῦσαι αὐτὸν τῷ τραύματι· λέγωμεν <δὲ> «τὰ
τὰ» τρίς, ἅμα τε ἐπιπτύοντες Ῥωμαῖαν τινὰ ῥῆσιν ἣ ἐν τῷ ἐκκειμένῳ πενταγώνῳ
<εʹ> ἔγκειται πρὸς τὰ σημεῖα χρωματικῆς, ἄλφα <ὕπτιον ὄπισθε γραμμὴν ἔχον καὶ
γάμμα> ἀπεστραμμένον ὄπισθε βʹ γραμμὰς ἔχον. Ἡ μὲν οὖν ἀλγηδὼν παύσεται· τὸ δὲ
τραῦμα ἰατρῶν παῖδες θεραπευέτωσαν, τοῦ κάμνοντος ἑαυτὸν εὐχερῶς ἐς τὴν
ἐπάφησιν αὐτῶν χορηγοῦντος.
pass_a_gloss: Toward the from-iron blow. Also for the one-struck from iron this is a pain-cure: the wounding iron one-ought to-smear, then strike-it-on the wound; let-us-say 'ta ta' thrice, while also spitting-on a certain Roman phrase which in the displayed pentagon 5 is-laid toward the chromatic signs: inverted alpha having a line behind and a turned-back gamma having two lines behind. The pain then will-cease; but the wound let physicians' sons treat, the sufferer readily furnishing himself toward their touching.
pass_b_english: For a wound from iron. For the one struck by iron this too is a cure of pain: one ought to smear the iron that wounded, then strike it against the wound. Let us say "ta ta" three times, while also spitting a certain Roman phrase which is laid in the pentagon set out, the fifth, toward the chromatic signs: an inverted alpha having a line behind, and a turned-back gamma having two lines behind.
The pain will then cease. Let the sons of physicians treat the wound, the sufferer readily furnishing himself to their touching.

choices.english: let us say "ta ta" three times
choices.why: The lock prints the syllables τὰ τὰ; they are not an article plus noun, and not a Scripture tag.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
